The person behind TESERACT

GireeshGireesh

Founder · Product Designer · Business & Technology

from01 — 03
aviationaviation
to
businessbusiness

From aviation to business. From business to technology. From technology to product design.

With nearly five years of professional experience across aviation, business, technology and digital innovation, Gireesh brings together a multidisciplinary perspective shaped by different industries and disciplines.

His journey began in aviation, followed by a transition into business and strategy, before moving into technology and ultimately product design. Today, he focuses on Product Design, UI/UX and interactive digital experiences, combining business thinking with design to turn complex ideas into products that are clear, intuitive and purposeful.

Over the years, Gireesh has worked across diverse digital projects, exploring the relationship between people, business and technology. His work has also extended into innovation challenges and hackathons, including a first-place hackathon achievement.

Why TESERACT exists/02

The idea behind TESERACT came from a simple observation: businesses with great ideas were often represented by digital experiences that felt exactly the same.

(tap to restore) 0/3

  • Templates replaced thinking.
  • Trends replaced identity.
  • Complexity replaced clarity.

Gireesh wanted to build something different. TESERACT was created to bring together strategy, design and technology to create digital experiences that are not only visually distinctive, but also meaningful, intuitive and built around the people using them.

For Gireesh, the goal is simple: build products people understand, create experiences people remember, and help businesses move beyond ordinary.
